evidence.title: Wispr Flow | Voice to Text Dictation & AI Notetaker

name: Wispr Flow
summary: Voice dictation app that turns speech into polished text in any app on Mac, Windows, iOS and Android, in 100+ languages.
description: AI voice-to-text dictation: hold a key, speak, and Flow types where your cursor is — no plugins, so it works in Gmail, Slack, Notion, terminals, code editors and AI tools. It auto-edits as you speak (removes filler words, adds punctuation, applies corrections), learns names and jargon through a personal dictionary, expands voice snippets and styles output per app. Notetaker adds meeting notes on Mac and Windows. Free tier plus paid Pro, Growth and Enterprise plans.
contains: dictation at 4x typing speed (220 wpm vs 45 wpm, site claim)
AI auto-edits: filler removal, punctuation, corrections and repetition
personal dictionary, voice snippets, tone styling and whisper mode
developer features: syntax-smart code dictation, Cursor and Windsurf integrations
Notetaker for Mac and Windows; works in ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor
free tier; Pro $15, Growth $23 per user/month; Enterprise custom
SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA and ISO 27001; privacy mode with zero retention
